g.text: AI compute is concentrated, but not in a single site

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: What it shows: the 15 largest sites by observed compute, and how much of the tracked total they account for. A useful

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: check on whether AI capacity is a handful of megasites or a broad build-out.

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Data Centers (CC-BY) — https://epoch.ai/data/ai-data-centers

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published data centers documentation

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Note: Observed data only, at the 2026-08-06 snapshot. The largest single site holds 8.6% of tracked compute, the top 10 hold 43.8% and the

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: top 20 hold 63.1%. 15 of 77 tracked sites have no observed compute yet - they are under construction, and they are counted in the

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: denominator. Concentration is measured across Epoch's coverage, which is deliberately biased toward the largest sites, so the real

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: market is less concentrated than this.
